camel_example: aliyun dts RenewInstance --region cn-hangzhou --DtsJobId qi0r643lc310000 --ChargeType PREPAY --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
description_en: Renews a DTS instance. This operation is applicable only to subscription DTS instances
description_zh: 可以为DTS实例续费。本接口仅适用于预付费类型的DTS实例
kebab_example: aliyun dts renew-instance --dts-job-id qi0r643lc310000 --charge-type PREPAY --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: RenewInstance

parameters.help_en: The ID of the data synchronization or change tracking task. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/209702.html to query the task ID
parameters.help_zh: 同步或订阅任务ID，可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/209702.html查询
parameters.name: dts_job_id

parameters.help_en: The billing method. Set the value to PREPAY, which indicates the subscription billing method
parameters.help_zh: 付费类型为PREPAY，包年包月（预付费）
parameters.name: charge_type

parameters.help_en:
The billing method for the renewal instance. Valid values:
Year: yearly subscription.
Month: monthly subscription (default)
parameters.help_zh:
续费实例的计费方式，取值：
Year：包年。
Month：包月（默认值）
parameters.name: period

parameters.help_en:
The subscription duration of the renewed instance. Default value: 1.
If Period is set to Year, the valid values are 1 to 5.
If Period is set to Month, the valid values are 1 to 60
parameters.help_zh:
续费实例购买时长，默认为1。
当Period为Year（包年）时，取值范围为1~5。
当Period为Month（包月）时，取值范围为1~60
parameters.name: buy_count

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region in which the DTS instance resides. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141033.html
parameters.name: region_id

ChargeType.description_en: The billing method. Set the value to PREPAY, which indicates the subscription billing method
ChargeType.description_zh: 付费类型为PREPAY，包年包月（预付费）

Code.description_en:
The error code.

This parameter will be deprecated
Code.description_zh:
错误码。

本参数即将下线

DtsJobId.description_en: The ID of the data synchronization or change tracking task

DynamicMessage.description_en:
The dynamic error message, which is used to replace the %s variable in the ErrMessage response parameter.

If ErrMessage returns The Value of Input Parameter %s is not valid and DynamicMessage returns DtsJobId, the request parameter DtsJobId is invalid
DynamicMessage.description_zh:
动态错误信息，用于替换返回参数ErrMessage错误信息中的%s。

如果ErrMessage返回The Value of Input Parameter %s is not valid，且DynamicMessage返回DtsJobId，则表示所传入的请求参数DtsJobId不合法

EndTime.description_en: The time when the renewal instance expires. The time is displayed in the format of yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZZZ (UTC). ZZZ indicates the full time zone offset ("+" or "-" followed by hours and minutes), for example, +00:00
EndTime.description_zh: 续费实例到期时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZZZ（UTC时间）。 ZZZ表示完整时区偏移量（“+”或“-”后面跟有小时和分钟），例如：+00:00

ErrCode.description_en: The error code returned when the call fails
ErrCode.description_zh: 调用出错时返回的错误码

ErrMessage.description_en: The error message returned when the call fails
ErrMessage.description_zh: 调用错误时返回对应的错误信息
ErrMessage.example: The request processing has failed due to some unknown error.

true: The request was successful.
false: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功，返回值：

true：请求成功。
